events.title: Update Notice
events.summary: Hello!This update focuses on changes to the game’s progression structure and item balance.Major ChangesMaximum Round Increased to 40The game can now progress up to Round 40.Item Options ReworkedVarious item effects and values have been adjusted to accommodate the expanded round progression.Other ImprovementsVarious UI, system, and gameplay improvements have been made for a smoother overall experience.We will continue working to improve the game and provide a better gameplay experience.Thank you

events.title: Update 0.0.2
events.summary: Hello!Thank you to everyone who played the demo and shared your valuable feedback.Based on your feedback, we have made the following improvements:Update NotesTutorial AddedAdded a tutorial to help new players better understand the game systems.High-Resolution UI ImprovementsImproved UI scaling and readability for QHD and UHD resolutions.We will continue to improve the game based on your feedback.Thank you for playing!

events.title: Lucky Pocket Demo Available on July 31!
events.summary: Hello, everyone!We're excited to announce that the Lucky Pocket Demo will be available starting July 31!This demo is an early look at the game, and your feedback will play a huge role in helping us improve it before the full release.We Want Your Feedback!We'd love to hear all of your thoughts, big or small.Please let us know about:🐞 Bugs or technical issues🎮 Gameplay and controls⚖️ Difficulty and balance💡 Features you'd like to see😊 What you enjoyed😕 Anything that felt frustrating or confusing✨
